capabilities.source_constraint: 水平地面、共轴向、等高/等宽/等距直线排，有限排数、无限轴向近似
capabilities.behavior_en: Equal height/width/pitch, common axis, horizontal finite ground; reject unsupported geometries.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 等高、等宽、等距、共轴、水平有限地面；拒绝超范围几何。

capabilities.source_constraint: 点、向量、线段、区间、遮挡分区、确定索引、退化处理
capabilities.behavior_en: Finite primitives, exact identity/topology and frame-specific active maps, including no-direct states.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 有限值原语、精确身份与拓扑、逐帧 active map，覆盖 no-direct 状态。

capabilities.source_constraint: 每排正/背面分别配置正整数 cut；加权聚合
capabilities.behavior_en: Independent positive front/back cuts per row; preserve keys and length-weighted sums.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 每排正背面独立正整数 cut；保留 key 与长度加权和。

capabilities.source_constraint: 投影、重叠消除、cut 点、边排行为、零倾角
capabilities.behavior_en: Ordered shadow projection, clipping, overlap removal and complete finite-ground partition.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 有序阴影投影、裁剪、消除重叠及有限地面完整分区。

capabilities.source_constraint: Hottel、邻排、地面、sky、互易性、遮挡
capabilities.behavior_en: Hottel/obstruction/neighbor/ground/sky; receiver-source axes and reciprocity.
capabilities.behavior_zh: Hottel、遮挡、邻排、地面与 sky；明确接收行/源列及互易性。

capabilities.source_constraint: 常数吸收、Rust 原生函数/参数化曲线、NumPy 输入曲线的纯 Rust求值；积分策略命名
capabilities.behavior_en: Separate F/G; named ReferenceMidpoint300; paired constant/function/SAPM/table curves evaluated in Rust.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 分离 F/G；具名 ReferenceMidpoint300；成对常数/函数/SAPM/表格曲线均在 Rust 求值。

capabilities.source_constraint: Full/Fast 内各自参考语义；总量与分量
capabilities.behavior_en: Isotropic source components in both Full and explicitly selected Fast.
capabilities.behavior_zh: Full 与显式选择的 Fast 各自具有 Isotropic 源分量语义。

capabilities.source_constraint: 1990 系数集、direct/isotropic/circumsolar/horizon、正背面
capabilities.behavior_en: Frozen 1990 coefficients and exact bins; component traces and approved corrections.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 冻结 1990 系数及精确分箱；分量 trace 与批准修正。

capabilities.source_constraint: 当前主路径的直射分区式遮挡和透光/间隙因子；不伪称已用光盘面积模型
capabilities.behavior_en: Direct-partition shading with tau; no dormant disk/Gaussian parameter.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 直射分区加 tau；不暴露未生效的光盘/Gaussian 参数。

capabilities.source_constraint: 背面参考行为；正面确认 bug 按 CDR-005 修正并单独验收
capabilities.behavior_en: Back behavior plus separately approved front correction and low-sun policy.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 背面行为加单独批准的正面修正与低日高政策。

capabilities.source_constraint: albedo 逐时或标量，rho 正背面；允许零反射率；间隙/透光参数
capabilities.behavior_en: Scalar/timeseries albedo; zero rho; explicit absorption and transmission configuration.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 标量/逐时 albedo；零 rho；明确吸收与透射配置。

capabilities.source_constraint: 无显式逆、可报告残差、奇异/资源错误；sky 边界
capabilities.behavior_en: Incident-form direct solve, residual/condition diagnostics, typed singular/resource failures.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 入射形式直接求解、残差/条件诊断、具名奇异/资源错误。

capabilities.source_constraint: Full 全部；Fast 只保证已定义的 qinc/反射分量，q0/qabs 标记 unavailable
capabilities.behavior_en: Full q0/qinc/qabs/components; Fast q0/qabs unavailable, never fabricated zero.
capabilities.behavior_zh: Full q0/qinc/qabs/分量；Fast q0/qabs 明确 unavailable，不伪造零。

capabilities.source_constraint: 所有物理表面反射平衡，row/side/segment 聚合
capabilities.behavior_en: Equilibrium of all physical surfaces; segment/side/row aggregation and keys.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 所有物理面反射平衡；按 key 聚合 segment/side/row。

capabilities.source_constraint: 显式选择某排背面、可选 segment；不是自动降精度档
capabilities.behavior_en: Explicit target row back and optional segment; preserve named one-bounce approximation.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 显式目标排背面及可选 segment；保留具名一次反射近似。

capabilities.source_constraint: 批输入、逐点状态、顺序恢复、可控中间量输出
capabilities.behavior_en: Broadcast/shape validation, original order, per-frame statuses, bounded optional trace.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 广播/形状验证、原序、逐帧状态、受限可选 trace。

capabilities.source_constraint: 纯 Rust；无 Python/pvlib/GEOS runtime
capabilities.behavior_en: Pure Rust consumer builds/runs without Python, pvlib, GEOS or binding dependency.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 纯 Rust 使用者可独立构建运行，不依赖 Python、pvlib、GEOS 或 binding。

capabilities.source_constraint: PyO3+maturin 候选，thin binding，macOS 双架构/Linux/Windows
capabilities.behavior_en: Thin ownership-safe binding; clean wheel install and Native parity on approved platform matrix.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 薄绑定、所有权安全；批准平台矩阵上干净安装 wheel 并与 Native 一致。

capabilities.source_constraint: 同一物理计算；外层 timestep/chunk 并行；可控制资源
capabilities.behavior_en: One physical kernel, deterministic ordering, bounded outer workers and cancellation/errors.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 同一物理核心、确定顺序、受限外层 worker、取消与错误传播。

capabilities.source_constraint: 确定性 cost model、诊断、benchmark 校准，不切换 Full/Fast
capabilities.behavior_en: Deterministic measured cost model, explainable plan, calibrated crossover, serial fallback.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 确定性实测成本模型、可解释计划、经校准切换点、串行回退。

capabilities.source_constraint: Reference 范围 [-100,100] 明示；大型阵列显式扩大，禁止静默越界
capabilities.behavior_en: Explicit default [-100,100] and configurable extent shared by geometry/VF/AOI; reject out-of-domain rows.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 显式默认 [-100,100] 与 Geometry/VF/AOI 共用可配置范围；拒绝越界排。

capabilities.source_constraint: 原始 oracle 不修改；修正与 reference 数值分离
capabilities.behavior_en: Immutable raw/approved data, field-level CDR deviations, independent oracles and versioned tolerance.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不可变 raw/approved 数据、字段级 CDR 偏差、独立 oracle 与版本化阈值。

capabilities.name_zh: Python classes/callback/report API 完整复刻
capabilities.source_constraint: 只提供语义 API；Pandas 用户适配可在外围完成
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Semantic API only; external Pandas adapters allowed.

capabilities.source_constraint: 不复制 Matplotlib/Shapely API
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。

capabilities.name_zh: SAM 数据库、太阳位置/追踪器/天气/电气模型
capabilities.source_constraint: 输入上游 Python 系统提供；支持显式 SAPM B0…B5 即可
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Inputs come from upstream systems; explicit SAPM B0-B5 supported.

capabilities.name_zh: 非等高/非等距/坡地/dual tilt/3D 端部效应
capabilities.name_en: Unequal rows/sloped terrain/dual tilt/3D end effects
capabilities.source_constraint: 必须新模型，不作为普通参数放行
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Requires a new model, not an ordinary V1 parameter.

capabilities.source_constraint: 不在 Rust 并行热路径回调 Python；曲线/系数输入替代
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: No Python callbacks in Rust parallel hot paths; use curves/coefficients.

capabilities.name_zh: 完整光盘 circumsolar 遮挡
capabilities.source_constraint: 原辅助函数不是现行主流程；需独立物理规格与 CDR
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Dormant helper; requires independent physics specification and CDR.

capabilities.source_constraint: V1 留边界，测得 crossover 后启用
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Defer until measured crossover supports adoption.

capabilities.source_constraint: 逐一核实 NumPy 与 ABI，不预先承诺
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Verify NumPy/ABI separately; no advance promise.

capabilities.name_zh: 更精确 AOI 积分 / 地面消元
capabilities.source_constraint: 用模型 revision/误差对照验证，不静默替换
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Separate model revision and error evidence; no silent replacement.

capabilities.source_constraint: WASM 先保持核心依赖可移植，V1 不发包承诺
capabilities.behavior_en: Excluded from V1 acceptance blockers.
capabilities.behavior_zh: 不作为 V1 验收阻塞项。
capabilities.constraint_en: Portable boundaries only; no V1 distribution promise.
